The hooves lack distinct definition, appearing to melt into the mud. The anatomical structure of the lower legs is vague, with some joints appearing missing or incorrectly aligned. The number of visible legs is confusing due to overlapping and merging forms.

The background hills have a slightly warped, painterly quality that doesn't align perfectly with the foreground perspective, suggesting a generative artifact in the depth layers.
